== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Pyre is a mysterious, misty flame that serves as a source of life and resurrection. It possesses the ability to bring individuals back to life, such as Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola, who can manifest in her room after restoring from its hazy light. This entity is distinct from magical armor or suits, as it operates through a different magical source. The Pyre was originally gifted to a character by a dying man who had been removed from stasis, intended to provide guidance during continuous combat. It is described as a light that sustains existence and can be summoned by an individual to look deeply into its essence.}}
